item.title: ChatGPT Market Share Falls to 45% While Google Gemini Climbs to 25% in 2026
item.description: By Adam Blacker - Director, PR, Apptopia Inc. Edited by Asim BN. The GenAI Chatbot app market has increased 152% YoY since last January. Google’s Gemini has gone from a 14.7% share of the market in January 2025 to a 25.2% market share in Jan 2026. ChatGPT has fallen from 69.1% to 45.3%. ChatGPT is losing share but this makes sense as new and capable entrants have launched. Last month, Grok’s daily active user (DAU) market share hit its highest point yet at 15.2%. item.title: AI-generated text is overwhelming institutions – setting off a no-win ‘arms race’ with AI detectors
item.description: Bruce Schneier, Harvard Kennedy School and Nathan Sanders, Harvard University Image by upklyak on FreepikIn 2023, the science fiction literary magazine Clarkesworld stopped accepting new submissions because so many were generated by artificial intelligence. Near as the editors could tell, many submitters pasted the magazine’s detailed story guidelines into an AI and sent in the results. And they weren’t alone. Other fiction magazines have also reported a high number of AI-generated submissions.

item.title: The Real Price of Digital Clutter in the Workplace
item.description: By Igor deVasconcelos. Edited by Asim BN.In today’s workplace, almost all work starts with a screen and digital clutter has become an invisible toll on productivity. From an overwhelming number of open tabs to full mailboxes and disorganized desktops, professionals lose not only time but something far more valuable than that. SmallPDF recently published a study revealing the impact of disorganization on digital workspaces not only on work itself but on motivation and professional growth as well.

item.title: Why The Real Cost of Working From Home Varies Wildly in US Cities
item.description: By Daniel Mercer. Edited by Asim BN.How much does it really cost to work from your living room? And, by the way, it really all depends on your zip code.
